id.title: Bertaruh Hidupku pada Jamur! Rahasia Petani Organik [Tentang Lingkungan Kami] 13 Mei 2026 (Rabu)
id.description:
[Tentang Lingkungan Kami]

Terletak di Dolsan, Yeosu, di ujung selatan semenanjung Korea, terdapat fasilitas budidaya misterius yang tampak seolah-olah tertutup salju putih tebal, tak peduli musim apa pun. Kim Sang-yong kembali ke kampung halamannya 27 tahun yang lalu, meninggalkan pekerjaan tetapnya, terpesona oleh "Jamur Surai Singa," sebuah nama yang asing baginya saat itu. Meskipun orang lain menyebut jalan budidaya tanaman asing dan perjalanan berat pertanian organik sebagai tindakan gegabah, ia mengatasi puluhan ribu percobaan dan kesalahan untuk menguasai rasa pahit jamur tersebut dan mencapai keajaiban pendapatan tahunan sebesar 700 juta won. Kini, ia memperluas cakrawala pertanian di luar budidaya hingga mencakup kopi hasil budidaya jamur dan makanan olahan, membuktikan dirinya sebagai model pertanian ramah lingkungan yang sukses. Kami bertemu dengan petani ini dan filosofi hidupnya yang tulus yang terkandung dalam harta karun putih Yeosu ini, yang dibudidayakan dengan keringat jujur.

snippet.description:

"믿었던 친구의 배신으로 깊은 상처를 입은 ‘지원‘. 세상으로부터 도망치듯 들어간 공장에서 누구보다 긍정과 다정함의 힘을 믿는 룸메이트 ‘주희‘를 만나는데, 갑자기 ‘Tango’를 함께 추자는 제안이 부담스럽기만 하다. 하지만 ‘지원’은 자신을 기다리며 건네는 ‘주희‘의 서툰 스텝을 따라가며 굳게 닫았던 마음의 문을 용기 내어 조금씩 열기 시작한다. 마침내 다시 누군가를 믿어보려던 찰나, 어린 조장 ‘한별’이 일으킨 사고에 ‘주희’와 함께 휘말린 ‘지원’의 일상은 흔들리기 시작하는데… 차가운 새벽 같은 삶에 따뜻한 햇살처럼 다가온 ‘Tango’. 완벽하지 않아도 괜찮다고 말할 수 있는 첫 스텝이 시작된다!

"Ji-won, deeply wounded by the betrayal of a friend she trusted. However, the sudden suggestion to dance the Tango together feels overwhelming. Yet, as Ji-won follows Ju-hee's clumsy steps while waiting for her, she musters the courage to slowly open the firmly closed door of her heart. Just as she is about to finally trust someone again, Ji-won's life begins to waver as she and Ju-hee get caught up in an accident caused by the young foreman, Han-byeol… Tango, which approaches her life like warm sunshine in a life as cold as dawn. snippet.description:
[어바웃 우리동네]
전남 광양엔 시간도 향기롭게 흐른다는 한 공방이 있다. 이곳의 공방장은 3천 평 농장을 누비던 '여장부'에서 이제는 꽃잎 하나에 마음을 덖는 '꽃쟁이'로, 20년 손때 묻은 흙을 빚는 '도예가'로 인생 2막을 살아가고 있다는 정희숙 작가, 그녀는 4월의 선물 같은 겹벚꽃으로 차를 내리고 꽃청을 담그며, 찰나의 봄을 영원히 간직하는 마법을 부린다. 삐뚤빼뚤한 수강생들의 도자기 속에서도 보석 같은 행복을 발견한다는 그녀. 찻잔 속에 다시 피어난 꽃 한 송이처럼, 시들지 않는 봄을 일궈가는 정희숙 작가의 따스한 공방 일기를 만나본다.

en-US.title: The Flower-Picking Potter, The Clay-Molding Flower Maker [About Our Neighborhood] April 29, 2026 ...
en-US.description:
[About Our Neighborhood]

In Gwangyang, Jeonnam, there is a workshop where it is said that time flows fragrantly. The workshop is run by artist Jeong Hee-sook, who is living the second act of her life—transforming from a "strong woman" who roamed a 3,000-pyeong farm into a "flower lover" who savors a single petal, and a "ceramic artist" who shapes clay stained with 20 years of hands. She brews tea and makes flower syrup with double cherry blossoms, a gift of April, casting a spell to preserve the fleeting moments of spring forever. She says she discovers gem-like happiness even within the imperfect pottery of her students. Like a single flower blooming anew in a teacup, we take a look at the warm workshop diary of artist Jeong Hee-sook, who cultivates a spring that never withers.

Sumi Pottery Flower Tea, 821 Seongbul-ro, Bonggang-myeon, Gwangyang-si, Jeollanam-do ☎0507-1309-6125

snippet.description:
[어바웃 우리동네]
고흥 양파밭에 워크걸이 떴습니다. 따뜻한 기후와 해풍을 맞고 자란 고흥 거금도 양파는 맵지 않아서 그냥 생으로 먹어도 달다고 하는데, 워크걸이 맛 본 진짜 양파 맛은 어땠을까? 양파라고 다 똑같은 양파가 아니다! 고흥 거금도에서 자라는 양파는 양파 중에서도 명품으로 불린다는 조생품종 양파라는데... 백옥처럼 하얀 양파는 시선을 강탈한다. 그리고 들어나 봤나? 양파 콜라겐 젤리! 이곳에서 직접 연구하고 만든 젤리는 자색 양파로 만든 콜라겐 젤리다. 출시하고 인기가 높아지고 있다고 하는데... 워크걸과 함께 고흥 거금도 양파를 수확하러 가보자.

en-US.description:
Jjangu

"Failed my 99th audition! Even if I fall, I'll try again!" Jjangu is a man from Busan who moved into Seoul to live on his own because he wants to become an actor. In a harsh life in Seoul where he can barely afford the electricity bill, things rarely go right. His lines get tangled, his Seoul accent gets even more twisted, and he loses to the push-and-pull game in his love life. But Jjangu brushes himself off when he falls and laughs even louder when he feels embarrassed. This is one way to endure when life doesn't go as planned. It isn't heavy. Yet, it isn't light either. It is funny, yet passionate.

en-US.description:
[About Our Neighborhood]

On the bustling main street in front of Suncheon National University, there is a special creative hideout that stops busy young people in their tracks. Operated by Kim Hye-bin, who transformed from a kindergarten teacher into a craft artist, this place unfolds as magic turns imagination into reality.
